system.description: Your blood boils with heat, and you become a conduit of wrath. Sustained. You cannot retreat from a foe you have struck, and you take d4 damage at the end of each of your turns in which you did not attack.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and your first hit deals 2x damage.
outcomes.success: While you sustain the spell, your melee attacks deal d12 damage.
outcomes.failure: Your melee attacks deal d12 damage until the end of your next turn, and the spell cannot be sustained.
outcomes.ruin: The fever burns inward: you take d4 persistent fire damage. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
